programmes.d: When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as the Thicket.

Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.
Left to fend for herself and her two children on a remote homestead in the middle of nowhere, a lonely widow strikes up a friendship with a grizzled, restless cowboy.
A hardened drifter (Tom Selleck) promises his dying friend that he will protect the man's wife (Virginia Madsen) and daughter, and their Wyoming homestead.
In 1885 a woman (Cate Blanchett) must join forces with her estranged father (Tommy Lee Jones) to rescue her kidnapped daughter (Evan Rachel Wood).
Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows.
Betrayed by his best friend (John Savage), a cowboy (Bill Pullman) must protect his herd from rustlers and risk losing his fiancée (Diane Lane).

After being wrongfully jailed on a murder charge, Cisco and Pancho escape to capture the real murderer.
